reason: An SSH remote workspace plugin that lets the agent browse and modify remote files, execute commands, and use remote terminals through SSH/SFTP, with persisted workspace mappings and connection status management.

summaries.zh: 通过 SSH 和 SFTP 连接远程工作区，支持浏览、读取、编辑远程文件以及执行命令和使用远程终端。
summaries.en: Connects to remote workspaces over SSH and SFTP to browse and edit files, execute commands, and use remote terminals.

capabilities: Connects to remote hosts over SSH
Browses, reads, writes, edits, lists, and stats remote files through SFTP
Executes shell commands on remote hosts
Maintains connection pools and automatic reconnection
